handoff.objective: Archive independent component review and scoped disposition
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Archive independent component review and scoped disposition
constraints: Only synthetic finite-field and linear-algebra component diagnostics. No elliptic-curve inputs, points, secret scalars, key recovery, discrete-log solver, relation collection, target descent, attack workflow or remote-target interface.

Passing this component does not complete either original experiment or test its original 20%/50% performance thresholds. Original specifications, task cards, claims, active V3 run and historical artifacts remain unchanged.
No asymptotic improvement, novelty, cryptanalytic or deployment inference. Runtime and exact operation counts are descriptive finite-fixture diagnostics only.
Root control plane executes Coordinator archive commands alone; preserve all other edits and stage exactly the declared archive paths.
Run alone; root control plane owns Git index/publication. Archive exactly own artifact_paths plus source tasks artifact_paths; record exact commit/parent/path hashes and verify reachability.

Write finite-component-only evidence and disposition with exact reviewed scope and failures; no original experiment/hypothesis/goal transition, speed threshold, novelty or cryptanalytic conclusion. Complete evidence schema and knowledge_promotion field truthfully.
completion_gate: Every declared artifact exists with truthful status/provenance; no omitted control or invented result.
Exact frozen specification, ownership, dependencies, source/plan/runtime/claim admission and archival path respected.
